en.title: Bulls Portföy announces liquidity statement
en.summary: Bulls Portföy disclosed that 56 percent of its 4.79 billion TL in managed assets are held in overnight money market operations, with 493 million TL in stocks and 371 million TL concentrated in high-liquidity BIST 30 companies. The firm attributed recent liquidity constraints to investor redemptions and bank credit pressures.

en.title: EU budget divides: 5 countries demand cuts
en.summary: Germany, Denmark, the Netherlands, Austria, and Finland, which finance 40 percent of the EU budget, rejected a proposed 2 trillion euro budget for 2028-2034. These five countries called for reductions of several hundred billion euros and reallocation of resources toward defense, security, and competitiveness.
